title: Read of the Century
transcript: Tomorrow, I'm playing against this guy. I found his online account and he always against the Caro-Kann, which is what I play, goes e6 and against Bishop f4, f5. And so, he's going to prep this line all night, but against f5, I have a line that goes Queen to d3 right away. This is the Manhattan Gambit, but of course, this doesn't work if he plays e6 and then f5. If I go Queen d3 here, he can just play d5 and be better. But, this guy has 1,400 games in this line and [music] always always always always goes f5. So, I am on zero wins. >> [music] >> I'm taking my chances. I'm going to go Queen d3 and if he plays f5, I'm going to go g4 and we're bowling. Dude, I'm telling you, this is not even chess, this is human psychology. I haven't even met the guy, I'm already in his head. I'm in this guy's head. >> [music]
